product_overview: Stock Composer is a web app to manage product master data, record batch-level inbound/outbound movements, and surface real-time inventory KPIs and trends. It provides authenticated users a single source of truth for on-hand quantities, batch traceability, and low-stock awareness.
core_goals: Provide authenticated access to product and inventory workflows.
Offer CRUD for products with SKU uniqueness enforced.
Capture inbound movements that create or update batches and update product totals.
Capture outbound movements that decrease batch quantities and prevent over-issuing.
Surface dashboard KPIs, low-stock alerts, composition and trend charts, and a read-only movement audit log.

features.name: User authentication
features.description: Allow users to register, sign in with email/password, maintain a session, and receive immediate success or error feedback.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email and password on login -> Submit login form -> Redirect to /dashboard -> See dashboard KPIs
Navigate to /login -> Fill email and password on login with invalid credentials -> Submit login form -> See toast on error and remain on /login
Navigate to /register -> Fill registration details -> Submit registration form -> Redirect to /dashboard -> See dashboard KPIs
Navigate to /register -> Submit registration form using an existing email -> See toast on error and remain on /register

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Show high-level inventory KPIs, low-stock list, stock composition and inbound/outbound trends to help users prioritize actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard while authenticated -> View total products and total units KPIs -> View low-stock panel reflecting products below min_stock -> View trend and composition charts when data exists
Navigate to /dashboard while unauthenticated -> Redirect to /login -> See login prompt
Navigate to /dashboard while authenticated with no inventory data -> See KPIs with zero or placeholders and empty-state charts explaining no data available

features.name: Product management
features.description: Create, edit, and delete product master records (name, SKU, unit, rack, min stock, category) with SKU uniqueness enforcement.
user_flows: Navigate to /products -> Create product by entering name and SKU and unit and rack and minimum stock -> Save product -> See new product listed in the products table
Navigate to /products -> Edit an existing product's rack or minimum stock -> Save changes -> See updated product details in the products table
Navigate to /products -> Attempt to create product using an existing SKU -> Submit product form -> See validation error preventing save and remain on /products
Navigate to /products -> Delete a product -> Confirm deletion flows per data rules -> See product removed from the products table or see blocked deletion message if constraints apply

features.name: Stock inbound
features.description: Record inbound stock by creating or updating a batch with batch number and date, increasing product totals and appending an inbound movement record.
user_flows: Navigate to /inbound -> Select product -> Enter quantity -> Enter batch number -> Enter inbound date -> Submit inbound form -> See successful confirmation and product totals updated
Navigate to /inbound -> Select product -> Enter quantity that is negative or leave required fields empty -> Submit inbound form -> See validation error and no movement recorded
Navigate to /inbound -> Select product -> Enter quantity for an existing batch number -> Submit inbound form -> See batch quantity increased and inbound movement appended to history

features.name: Stock outbound
features.description: Record outbound stock by selecting a product and a specific batch, reducing the batch quantity, and appending an outbound movement while preventing over-issuing.
user_flows: Navigate to /outbound -> Select product -> Select batch -> Enter outbound quantity that is less than or equal to batch quantity -> Enter optional note -> Submit outbound form -> See successful confirmation and product totals updated
Navigate to /outbound -> Select product -> Select batch -> Enter outbound quantity greater than selected batch quantity -> Submit outbound form -> See validation error and outbound rejected
Navigate to /outbound -> Select product -> Select batch with exact quantity -> Submit outbound form -> See batch depleted in inventory and outbound movement recorded

features.name: Movement history
features.description: Provide a read-only audit table of inbound and outbound movements showing time, type, product/batch context, quantity, user, and notes.
user_flows: Navigate to /movements -> View movement log table listing time, type, product, batch, quantity, user, and notes -> Confirm recent movements appear in chronological order
Navigate to /movements with no recorded movements -> See empty-state message indicating no movements have been recorded
Navigate to /movements -> Filter or sort movement rows as supported by the UI -> See filtered or sorted results (where filter/sort features exist)
